note: Built-in official list prices used ONLY to estimate and cap simple-mode runs. Where a vendor has peak/off-peak or tiered prices, the HIGHEST applicable figure is kept as a safety margin (peak hours; the up-to-1M-token input tier). Not a bill: always reconcile with the vendor console. Simple mode converts CNY to USD at the fixed rate public/smart-plan.js FX = 7.5 CNY per USD. Models not listed here have no catalog price (see lib/prices.js for the conservative estimated ceiling of known platforms).
